neighbours.label: the slot where someone's look or feeling is described: ' look', ' feeling', ' so' or ' very' before a word like well, alert, nice or friendly; the same frames with plain actions and places stay low
fire: My mother had a cold and did not look well at dinner.
Hotel staff very warm and helpful throughout our stay.
They were polite and everyone was so kind to us.
Take this tea at night and wake up feeling rested.
He came back from the trip and seemed very tired.
The nurse was gentle and the doctors were so caring.
After the swim I came home feeling calm and happy.
She looked so pale that we called the clinic.
quiet: My mother had a meal and did not go out at dinner.
Hotel staff work in the kitchen throughout our stay.
They were downstairs and everyone was at the bar.
Take this bus at night and arrive at seven.

short: describing how someone looks or feels
